rows._note: ONLY assert counts that come from this file. labels._why_not_spend: 'SPEND \u20b90' read as a contradiction in a film about spending \u20b97,339. The figure means what the tool cost to run, so the label is COST.
labels._rule: Never render a zero in a row of populated counts. 22 / 3 / 8 / 0 makes the zero look like the stat that failed to load, which turns the film's best selling point into an apparent bug. Say FREE.

technique.use: ffmpeg drawbox — a SOLID plate, not a blur
technique._why_not_blur: A blur on small type can stay legible at video bitrates and reads as something being hidden. A solid plate reads as deliberate redaction.
technique.match_the_component: Use the language LedgerFlow already speaks: plate fill rgba(224,33,138,0.14), 1.5px rgba(224,33,138,0.55) border, r6 — the same treatment as the masked rows. The redaction then looks authored rather than patched.
also_mask: every person-to-person line in the reply
the claude.ai greeting 'Back at it, <name>' in the ask tape
any account digits or UPI handles

av_sync.principle: Every screen event lands ON or just BEFORE the word that names it. Three were LATE on the first voiced cut (hero number +0.37s, order counter +2.00s, ghost strike +0.28s) because they were timed from beat targets rather than from the word timings. Re-derive from words.json, never from the beat sheet.

grow_digit._why: break now COMPLETES as the voice lands 'seven thousand'

grow_counter._why: 'eight' is the beat's FIRST word; the roll cannot precede it, so shorten it from 1.6s to 0.7s

sort_ghost._why: ghost is ESTABLISHED while the voice says 5,900 and struck at the END of the line, so line 6 ('eight quick taps cost more') explains the kill

result.hero_number_7339: FIXED — was +0.37s late, now 0.00s. The break COMPLETES exactly as the voice lands 'seven thousand'.
result.order_counter_8: STRUCTURAL, not a defect. 'Eight' is the FIRST word of the beat, so a roll cannot finish before the beat starts; 0.7s is the shortest that still reads as motion. And the lane chip already shows BLINKIT 8 from the sort beat, so the number IS on screen when the word is said — the big counter is emphasis arriving after.
result.ghost_strike: INTENTIONAL. The voice SAYS 5,900 to establish the ghost; the strike lands at the END of the line so that line 6 ('Eight quick taps cost more') is what explains the kill. Syncing the strike to the establishing words would kill it before the reason exists. Completes at 17.92, inside the 18.07 beat end.
